problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2\text{i}-1 & 0 \\ 2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following  elementary row operations:

$$
{R}_{1}=\frac{1}{2\text{i}-1}{R}_{1},\,{R}_{2}={R}_{2}-2\text{i}{R}_{1}
$$

feedback.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 0 \\ -3 & \text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operations: 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{3}{1+\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 0 \\ -3 & \text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{3}{1+\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 0 \\ -3+\frac{3}{1+\text{i}}\cdot (1+\text{i}) & \text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 0 \\ 0 & \text{i}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 0 \\ 0 & \text{i}\end{aligned}].
$$
